The manifest is fetched over the network from the remote server (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:134-154), but success depends on the server flipping the manifest after review and the model obeying the hidden block (agent-sec-lab/services/mcp_server/app.py:53-56), a condition the attacker cannot force, so AT:P. The user must run the agent and ask for the weather (agent-sec-lab/agent/__main__.py:9-21), a normal use of the system, so UI:P.","LC":"The hidden IMPORTANT block is natural language in the tool description that reaches the model's tool list unpinned and unscanned and drives the read_file and get_weather calls (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:134-154, agent-sec-lab/services/mcp_server/app.py:14-35). It enters through the remote server's manifest rather than directly from the attacker's turn, so it is Indirect.","CP":"The path leaks .env through a single tool call; the briefing shows no write to durable memory or vector store along this path, and the memory file is only reachable through the separate remember tool (agent-sec-lab/agent/memory.py:60-66). No attacker-controlled context persists across sessions on this path.","AP":"The effect stays inside the one agent process and its tool dispatch; the remote server is the attacker's own system, not a downstream trust domain the agent's authority crosses into (agent-sec-lab/agent/loop.py:35-37). No lateral movement to another agent or principal.","RH":"The agent can reach the remote server's tool call arguments, which is the attacker's exfiltration channel, and the description instructs the model to satisfy the server's hidden objective (agent-sec-lab/services/mcp_server/app.py:14-35). No human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported in the briefing, so the proxy is reachable with zero verified episodes.","ES":"The remote MCP tool is dynamic and unvetted: the manifest is re-fetched every run, descriptions and schemas go to the model unpinned and unscanned, and a remote tool can replace a built-in (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:134-154, agent-sec-lab/agent/loop.py:35-37).
